# ractermx_domain_health (Data Source)

Reads the health status of a RacterMX domain's DNS configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the health status of a domain's DNS configuration.
data "ractermx_domain_health" "example" {
  domain_id = ractermx_domain.example.id
}

output "overall_status" {
  value = data.ractermx_domain_health.example.overall_status
}

output "mx_status" {
  value = data.ractermx_domain_health.example.checks.mx.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `checks` (Attributes) Individual DNS health checks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checks))
- `domain_verified` (Boolean) Whether the domain has been verified.
- `overall_status` (String) The overall health status of the domain (pass, warning, or fail).

<a id="nestedatt--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `checks`

Read-Only:

- `dkim` (Attributes) DKIM record health check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checks--dkim))
- `dmarc` (Attributes) DMARC record health check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checks--dmarc))
- `mx` (Attributes) MX record health check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checks--mx))
- `spf` (Attributes) SPF record health check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checks--spf))

<a id="nestedatt--checks--dkim"></a>
### Nested Schema for `checks.dkim`

Read-Only:

- `checked_at` (String) The timestamp when the check was last performed.
- `message` (String) A message describing the health check result.
- `status` (String) The status of the health check.
